new. Same scene, a different view. Open weights on your own machine. Make the
next take, run the scene. Recast the lead, keep the move. Five more dancers in
the groove. Words to video, still to light. Pull the camera, cut it right. An
agent cuts it, frame by frame. Forty-four tools, still the same. On the
beat... on the beat... Cut to the beat. Your clip! Your models! Your call!
Paint it, change it, make it new. Make the next take, run the scene.
Aftertake.
